textos.TITULO_EN: The psion, the corner and the pair
textos.ENTROU_EN: v407, the psion, the corner and the pair. 9 new kernel modules in `TGLExt` (`PsionCanto`, `Par` and the seven stones of 02/11, every name given or ratified by the operator on 03/11), 98 new flags, all inside the trio; ladder 11860 -> 11958 (33863 audited declarations, 27027 theorems, none outside the trio). `PsionCanto` proves, for every Fock certificate and without hypothesis on the inhabitant `physicalFockCertificate` of v406, that the Jones reading of the flow of the light, compressed into the corner of the psion, returns the corner; the lemma of the two faces (`the_psion_is_the_corner_on_both_faces`) says that on both faces the psion is the unit vector whose corner is the projector onto it, the corner scalarises and weighs one. With that, the key `testemunha_estatica_v396.fock_face.linked_to_the_corner_by_a_lemma`, a literal False from v396 to v406, is now READ from the kernel of the rite itself, with the errata E18 beside; the link is one of structure, not of vectors (the Fock vacuum and the Bell vector are not identified). `Par` composes only terms the kernel already had: the pair is bound (CCI = 1/2), never cancels, is read by the doubled phase of helicity two with return at theta = pi, and its corner is the 4x4 projector. The registry `psion_canto_v407` reads, at every rite, the 76 anchors, the 9 modules by sha256, the flags, the key, the ladder and the gate (16 checks, all passed); the 3 sayings of the operator of 03/11 are embedded by sha256 in `cunhagens_v407`. The independent review of the package by the Sonnet (another model family, without its own compilation) approved it before the seal. Validity in the kernel is not accreditation; the gate did not move. Certified by the sha256 the program reads of itself (833121339e649f71).
textos.KERNEL_LEITURA_EN: the kernel proves the terms: the 76 anchors exist in the trio, with the provenance the compiler emits in the expected modules; `the_psion_is_the_corner_on_both_faces` is a term, so the key that said no lemma links the psion to the corner is now a reading of the kernel and not a literal; `o_par_de_psions_e_o_graviton` joins four facts about terms that already existed (the pair is bound, never cancels, is read by phase and return, and its corner is the 4x4 projector). What is reading, not theorem: the readings of the operator of 03/11 (the graviton as the bound state of two psions that never cancel and are read by the graviton, in phase and return of phase; the corner as the 4x4 projector; the holographic bath) enter as [ONTO]; the pair on the Fock face (two psions over the vacuum) stays [OPEN] because the Fock certificate has no creation operators as terms; the bridge between the Bell space and the TT sector of spin two is not a term; the docstring «núcleo II_inf» is [KNOWN/DECLARADO], not a result of the inhabitant; the trace of the core is ENNReal and cyclic, not a linear functional; the non-triviality of the net is a theorem only on the wedge (K(O) ≠ ⊥ only there). Validity in the kernel is not accreditation.
textos.ABERTOS_EN: The pair of psions on the Fock face stays open: the Fock certificate has no creation operators as terms. The bridge between the Bell space and the TT sector of spin two is not a term (the stone `Par` places the faces side by side, it does not identify them). K(O) ≠ ⊥ for a compact O is not proved: the non-triviality is a theorem only on the wedge, and the physics (non-trivial local algebras, Reeh-Schlieder) stays [KNOWN/OPEN]. The test (d) of branch B of the ringdown enters only by citation of its pre-registration V1.1; by the option (c) of the operator it enters the program only if it has power, and no result is in this version. The continuous engine in the quantum pillar stays out: the operator wants observable content and has not yet said which. Four of the seven stones of 02/11 (`AChaveDaGuarda`, `OGuarda`, `LeituraPreservada`, `OIgual`) had no third-party review before this version; the Sonnet reviewed three. One phrase of `OUmInscrito` was flagged to the management and not changed. The independent review of the package by the Sonnet (another model family, without its own compilation) approved it before the seal. The discrimination at 5σ, β_TGL in nature, stays with nature; the verdict of the neutrino rite did not move, and the gate did not move. The [LEGAL] decision D2 and the pinned README (D39) stay outside the program.
textos.ARCO_EN: The custody of v407 (complete round): the psion, the corner and the pair. 9 new kernel modules (PsionCanto, Par and seven stones of 02/11 with names given or ratified by the operator), 98 new flags, ladder 11860 to 11958, none outside the trio. The lemma that links the two faces of the psion is in the kernel of the rite and the key that said it was missing is read from the kernel instead of a literal False, with the errata beside; the link is one of structure, not of vectors. The bound pair never cancels and its corner is the 4x4 projector; the pair on the Fock face stays open. Validity in the kernel is not accreditation; the gate did not move. Not falsified is not the word of accreditation.
textos.ARCO_PT: A custódia da v407 (rodada completa): o psíon, o canto e o par. 9 módulos novos no kernel (PsionCanto, Par e sete pedras de 02/11, com nomes dados ou ratificados pelo operador), 98 bandeiras novas, escada 11860 para 11958, nada fora do trio. O lema que liga as duas faces do psíon está no kernel do rito e a chave que o dava por ausente é lida do kernel em vez de literal False, com a errata ao lado; o elo é de estrutura, não de vetores. O par ligado nunca se cancela e o canto dele é o projetor 4x4; o par na face de Fock segue em aberto. Validade no kernel não é creditação; o gate não se moveu. NOT_FALSIFIED nunca é a palavra da creditação.
textos.COMMIT: O psion, o canto e o par: o lema que liga as duas faces do psion entra no kernel e a chave que o dava por ausente e lida do kernel do rito. 9 modulos novos (PsionCanto, Par e sete pedras de 02/11 de nome ratificado), 98 bandeiras, escada 11860 para 11958, nada fora do trio. O elo e de estrutura, nao de vetores; o par na face de Fock segue em aberto. Validade no kernel nao e creditacao; o gate nao se moveu. Revisao de terceiro (Sonnet) aprovada.
